name: InitTargetFollower
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x47: after the base set-up sets +0x578 and +0x598 to -1, the two floats 3000 and 1000, gives the list at +0x55C a link offset of 0x7B0 and the three tuning values 25, 0, 0.25, and clears D_002629C8

name: LoadTargetFollowerRecords
evidence: slot 10 of class 0x47: loads the five id-keyed records of table D_002629D0, then finds the entry of its list at +0x550 whose two ends have ids 0x2EF and 0x2F0 and keeps a float of its object at +0x5A4

name: ResolveTargetFollowerLinks
evidence: slot 20 of class 0x47: loads table D_00262A10, creates the walker for list +0x550, finds the kind-0x8C child, stores the z offset to its target, re-follows the stored id through FollowObjectById and sets a flag bit

name: FollowObjectById
evidence: stores the id at +0x578, looks the object up in the world (func_0015A448) and, when found, makes it the followed object (SetFollowedObject) and calls func_0016D788 and func_0016DAC0 with mode 2 or 4 by the object's +0x7AC

name: StepTargetFollower
evidence: slot 0x80 of class 0x47: runs StepCollider and, unless +0x5D8 is set, turns about the z axis by the angle at +0x5A0 (BuildAxisAngleMatrix) and steps its sub-object at +0x5B0 (func_001B9D10)

name: UpdateTargetFollower
evidence: original assembly: slot 0x54 of class 0x47

name: ChooseTargetFollowerMode
evidence: by the mode at +0x598 (jtbl_0024A810) returns the mode the follower should enter: follows the object at +0x560 when it changes, waits for its arrival (+0x5AC) and start (+0x5A8) times, and picks an entry table object (ChooseEntryTableObject) once the time at +0x574 has passed; UpdateTargetFollower calls it

name: SetFollowedObject
evidence: stores the class 0x2A object at +0x558; when its +0x7AC differs from +0x5D0 takes it and sets +0x5D4 to 3, copies a float into the child at +0x570 and creates or frees the record at +0x5BC

name: LaunchPoolItemAtTarget
evidence: aims the chosen item of the object pool at +0x570 at the chosen object +0x590 (GetObjectWorldPosition), by its kind 0x3D or 0x3E setting its launch speeds from the followed object's tuning floats (+0x320..+0x334), releases it (func_001A8C90) and sets the next time at +0x574; HandleTargetFollowerNotification calls it for code 0x2FD

name: PlaceTargetFollowerOnFollowed
evidence: anchors the follower (SetColliderAnchors), clears its two motion vectors and places it at the followed object's point (func_001920B0) raised by +0x56C (FollowObjectById and func_0016DAC0 call it)

name: LaunchTargetFollowerAtFollowed
evidence: aims the follower at the followed object's point (+0x558's +0x7A4, raised by +0x56C) on an arc (func_001EDEF0), anchors it (SetColliderAnchors) and gives it that velocity through slot 0x90, then sets its arrival time +0x5AC and start time +0x5A8 from the horizontal distance over speed

name: StartRandomStreamVoice
evidence: when +0x5C0 is set and no stream voice is active, a roll below 20 of 100 picks one of the seven 32-byte KeyRecords of D_002482D8 at random, opens it (OpenKeyRecord) and sets +0x5CC

name: PlayPendingFollowerSound
evidence: when a sound is pending (+0x5CC) and func_001BE810 no longer holds, clears it and plays it with the volume and pan at +0x5C4 and +0x5C8 (PlaySoundAndApplyVolumePan)

name: HandleTargetFollowerNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x47: runs the base handler, then on message type 0x13 maps the codes 0x2FD, 0x2FE, 0x2FF and 0x300 to func_0016D490, StartRandomStreamVoice, func_0016DAC0 (mode 2) and func_0016D828

name: SetTargetFollowerMode
evidence: changes the mode at +0x598 and stamps the clock at +0x59C, then by the mode (jtbl_0024A830) sets the heading +0x5A0, the times or the chosen object (ChooseEntryTableObject) and moves its state walker (+0x554) to the mode's state 0x2EF..0x2F6 (SetStateWalkerTarget); FollowObjectById, UpdateTargetFollower and HandleTargetFollowerNotification call it

name: SetCurrentTargetFollower
evidence: stores its argument in D_002629C8, the follower that FollowableObject messages and InitTargetFollower use

name: ClearCurrentTargetFollower
evidence: sets g_currentTargetFollower to 0 (the script built-in func_00106560 calls it)

name: InitEntryTableObject
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x64 class: calls the base set-up func_00123ED0 then stores the seven tuning floats at 0x31C..0x334

name: LoadEntryTable
evidence: slot 10 of the 0x64 class: after the base load, func_0015A4F0 fills the sixteen-entry table at 0x2D0 and the count (clamped to 0x10) is stored at 0x310

name: StartEntryTableObject
evidence: slot 0x50 of class 0x64: runs StartPlacedObject, then its slot 3

name: ChooseEntryTableObject
evidence: picks one object of the entry table (+0x2D0, count +0x310): a random one in mode 0 (+0x314), the one nearest the active switched collider in mode 1 (GetObjectWorldPosition), else none; func_0016D1E0 and func_0016DAC0 call it

name: InitFollowableObject
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x2A: after the base set-up clears the zone duration and sets the ids at +0x7A0 and +0x7A8 to -1

name: ResolveFollowableObjectLinks
evidence: slot 19 of class 0x2A: after the base step finds the object by id +0x7A0 (kind 4) or else the first class 0x7E child, and the object by id +0x7A8, storing them at +0x7A4 and +0x7AC

name: HandleFollowableObjectNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x2A: after the base handler, kinds 2, 0xC and 0xD remove it from, append it to or remove it from the list at +0x55C of the current follower D_002629C8
